# Reference journey fixture

Deterministic offline fixture used by the end-to-end runner and validator tests. It contains four synthetic signals, two patterns, one opportunity, one initiative, four PRDs, one learning, and one product update.

Provider snapshots, people, dates, URLs, baselines, targets, and observed results are synthetic. This fixture verifies repository contracts and provenance handling; it is not a human-facing product example and makes no production claim.
